overview: Yeah1 Group is a media, entertainment and technology ecosystem, and its corporate website is the front door: business activities, investor relations and news, all in Vietnamese and English. blocks.text: Coverage centred on the key user journeys through the site: moving between sections, reading content pages, and browsing on desktop and mobile. - Navigation across sections

- Responsive layouts

overview: UIT — the University of Information Technology, VNU-HCMC — runs an AI consultation chatbot that answers prospective and current students. I tested the chatbot itself: not just whether it replies, but whether its replies are right, and how it behaves when a conversation goes off track.

blocks.text: Testing focused on response accuracy, conversation flows, UI behavior and out-of-scope question handling — the four places a consultation chatbot earns or loses trust. A wrong answer, a broken flow, or a confident reply to a question it should not answer are all defects, and each one was reported with the exact conversation that produced it.

- Response accuracy
- Conversation flows
- UI behavior
- Out-of-scope question handling

My process on this project followed the same steps I use on every engagement: requirement analysis first, so testing covers the conversations users actually have; test case design around the main flows and the edge cases; test execution with clear bug reports; bug reproduction and fix verification after each fix; and regression testing before release, so a fix in one place does not break another.
